'''Xoltyr N'lson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] residing on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] around [[3642 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Xoltyr N'lson appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Balmorra. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
